selection: Production Swift embedder uses only the wasmi-backed TraverseSwiftHost binary target. WasmKit was removed from the package (issue #1469 / Decision 96 item 11) because WasmKit 0.2.2 fails on current Xcode toolchains and was never the production resource-control path.
security_boundary: SHA-256 digest verified before instantiation; ambient imports rejected; fuel and memory ceilings enforced via TraverseHostLimits; no WasmKit dependency in the production product.
known_limitations: WasmKit is not supported and is not a package dependency.
